meta.title: Awarding page full screen and hidden fields
warnings: resolved: “Selecting an unspecified hidden column and verifying that the selected column appears in the fullscreen grid, because th” — expect_options opens the list and reads what it offers, with greyed-out items

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ summary as the mandatory first step.
Navigate to the event's Master QCS so the awarding flow can be opened.
Open the awarding page for the closed event.
Verify that the awarding flow reached its proposal/awarding screen.
Enter fullscreen mode on the awarding grid.
Verify fullscreen mode is active and the grid-only view exposes the exit control.
Open the hidden-fields control on the fullscreen awarding grid.
Verify the hidden-fields menu lists eight hidden column options.
